name: pi-workspace
title: Pi workspace layout
description: ArtifactWorkspace: the chat with a right-hand panel that slides in at full height, a resizable divider, full screen, a full-screen sheet on a phone and an opt-in float-when-narrow (the host swaps in AmbientChat from pi-ambient). Layout only; what is open is the host's. Pair it with the viewers item for the panel contents. Also dock.tsx, which re-exports the docks of the dock item (DockLayout, Dock, DockMain, useDock) for any host content on the left or right of the main area, each resizable, floatable, closable and a full-screen sheet on a phone.

files.content:
// The docks live in the `dock` item; this re-export keeps `pi-workspace/dock` imports working unchanged.
export * from '../dock/dock';
